honest_c3: C1 — mac CPU fp32 numerical noise floor low; argmax greedy decode tie-breaking deterministic for this run but not guaranteed stable across torch builds. Single-pass measurement.

C2 — ln_f weight (gain) ablation = single-component intervention. RMSNorm formula = x * weight / rms(x); we vary weight only, leaving the rms-normalization step intact. A 'true' RMSNorm collapse hypothesis would also need rms(x) variation or full pre-ln_f hidden replacement; this probe isolates GAIN, not whole-norm pathology.

C3 — single prompt 안녕하세요. 오늘 날씨가 좋네요. (KO long greeting). One-prompt result is anecdotal; ln_f gain effect may be prompt-conditional. Per-prompt variance not measured. Broader prompt sweep needed before generalizing 'ln_f IS / ISN'T a basin contributor'.

C4 — 'semi-coherent' heuristic is anima-internal: requires len>=5, korean+ascii letters>=5, max-char-frequency <=50%. False-positive risk: (a) text with high diversity but no semantic content (e.g. random unicode-letter spam); false-negative risk: (b) actually-coherent short emit <5 chars. Heuristic is screening tool, not ground-truth coherence judge.

C5 — weight modification BY CONSTRUCTION changes output distribution; coherence emergence under any non-baseline config is consistent with multiple causal stories: ln_f gain critical (intended hypothesis), OR perturbation-noise that randomly-jolts decode out of degenerate fixed-point (null), OR scale-induced numerical instability shifting argmax non-meaningfully. PASS verdict shows ln_f IS a basin LEVER, not necessarily THE basin cause.
